recovery.label: Error Recovery
recovery.title: Recovery Means Making Progress.
recovery.takeaway: Two early errors, then a complete task. Compare recovery with repeated errors that leave the score unchanged.
recovery.question: Correction → Progress → Completion
recovery.answer: Opus 5.5 finishes at 1.0; DeepSeek-1017 stops at 0.5 after three final code errors.

sequence.label: Goal Progress
sequence.title: More Motion. Less Progress.
sequence.takeaway: 338 action submissions complete five goals; 501 submissions complete none.
sequence.question: Actions ≠ Completed Goals
sequence.answer: Opus 5.5 completes 5/5 goals with 338 action submissions; Gemini completes 0/5 with 501.

drawer.label: Task Completion
drawer.title: A Valid Action Can Still Miss the Goal.
drawer.takeaway: Fable 5.1 opens the drawer in 20 rounds. Sol reaches its 24-round limit without opening it.
drawer.question: Call Accepted ≠ Task Complete
drawer.answer: The final drawer check succeeds for Fable 5.1 and fails for Sol.

goal.label: Goal Conditions
goal.title: The Whole Instruction Matters.
goal.takeaway: Eight rounds each. Gemini meets all three goal conditions; DeepSeek-1017 meets one.
goal.question: Partial Progress ≠ Completion
goal.answer: The goal requires the cleaned soap bar in the bathtub. Gemini meets 3/3 conditions; DeepSeek-1017 meets 1/3.

time.label: Decision Latency
time.title: Fewer Decisions Can Take Longer.
time.takeaway: All three agents reach the chair. Compare elapsed time alongside decision count.
time.question: Decisions ≠ Elapsed Time
time.answer: Astra: 18 rounds / 471 s. Sol: 17 / 669 s. DeepSeek-1017: 65 / 406 s.

horizon.label: Budget Limits
horizon.title: Time Is Not the Only Limit.
horizon.takeaway: Eight agents stop without completing the toolbox. Token and round limits end these attempts before the 180-minute ceiling.
horizon.question: Time · Tokens · Rounds
horizon.answer: These eight episodes end at token or round limits, with no successful toolbox completion.

precision.label: Contact Precision
precision.title: Hundreds of Steps. No Insertion.
precision.takeaway: Hundreds of control steps still leave the charger outside the required final pose.
precision.question: Motion ≠ Successful Contact
precision.answer: Qwen Max and Qwen 397B reach 400 native steps; DeepSeek-1017 reaches 385. None completes the insertion.
